summary: Validated 'Opname Per Kategori' feature plus Kasir inventory panel money hiding. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases pass (admin money fields present; kasir money fields fully hidden on items/categories/total; bulk opname via category-load works for admin & kasir and preserves stock when fisik==sistem). Frontend: admin + kasir flows exercised via Playwright. Category select is A-Z sorted with counts (Alat(1), Benih(1), Pestisida(1), Pupuk(2)); 'Tambah Semua' adds all products of a category, session counter shows '0/2 dihitung' → '2/2 dihitung' after fills, save succeeds and clears session. No-category click shows error toast. Second click after loading same category gracefully handled. Kasir sees inventory-value-panel without any money labels (Nilai Modal / Nilai Jual / Potensi Laba / Harga Beli not present) and category chips filter the Jumlah Barang card and table. Kasir also has the opname-category select + Tambah Semua button available. All test-created opname rows cleaned up afterward.
critical_code_review_comments: OpnameSessionForm uses `products.filter(...).sort(...)` for category add which is correct and sorted by name as spec requires.
InventoryValuePanel chip testid uses raw category name (`inventory-category-Pupuk`); if a category contains spaces or special chars the selector may need escaping, but current categories are safe.
Backend inventory_value correctly strips money fields for non-admin via dict comprehension on items/categories/total.
